modelOverview: The Aquanaut 5168G is the white-gold 'Jumbo' expression of Patek Philippe's sports-luxury Aquanaut line, stepping up from the steel 5167A's 40.8mm case to a larger 42.2mm case rendered in precious metal with a matching composite strap. The 5168G family was launched in 2017 to mark the Aquanaut's 20th anniversary with a blue-dialled 5168G-001, followed in 2019 by the bold khaki green 5168G-010. Both pair the manufacture's self-winding Calibre 26-330 S C with a distinctive embossed dial colourway, making the 5168G one of the more eye-catching gold sports references in the current Patek catalogue.

5168G-010.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 26-330 S C · 35–45h power reserve
5168G-010.materials: 18k white gold case on a matching khaki green composite (Tropical rubber) strap with white gold fold-over clasp
5168G-010.bezel: White gold rounded octagonal bezel with alternating polished and satin-brushed finishes, no visible screws
5168G-010.dial: Khaki green varnished dial embossed with the Aquanaut pattern, white gold applied Arabic numerals and baton hands with luminescent coating, date aperture at 3 o'clock
5168G-010.description: Introduced in 2019 for the Aquanaut's 20th anniversary, the 5168G-010 is the 'Jumbo' white-gold model with a striking khaki green embossed dial and matching strap, distinguishing it from the standard steel Aquanaut. It runs the self-winding Calibre 26-330 S C with sweep seconds and date beneath a sapphire caseback, in an 18k white gold case with screw-down crown. Each example offered is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.

variants.White Gold – Green: 5168G-010 in 18k white gold on its signature khaki green composite strap with matching embossed khaki green dial, the defining colourway for this reference.
